description: Insider transactions for a public company from its recent SEC Form 4 and 4/A filings (officers, directors and 10% owners), newest first. Pass exactly one of `ticker` or `cik`. Each filing lists the insiders (name, CIK, director/officer/10% owner, officer title), the Rule 10b5-1 plan checkbox (aff_10b5_1; null on pre-2023 filings, and plan details often also appear in footnotes) and every transaction: security, date, code and its meaning (P open-market purchase, S sale, A grant, M/X option exercise, F tax withholding, G gift, ...), acquired_disposed, shares, price, value (shares x price), shares_owned_after, direct_or_indirect and footnote text; derivative rows add exercise price, dates and the underlying security. `summary` totals open-market purchases (P) and sales (S) across the returned original Form 4s and counts distinct insiders. `limit` is how many Form 4 filings to scan (default 10, max 20); `codes` keeps only matching transactions and drops filings with none, so fewer filings than `limit` can come back. `since` (YYYY-MM-DD) stops at older filings. Searches EDGAR's recent-filings list (`coverage_from` gives its oldest date). Returns "not_found" for an unknown ticker or CIK. Paid: $0.01 USDC per successful call on Base via x402; failed lookups are not charged.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. "320193" or "0000320193"

codes.description: Only these transaction codes, e.g. ["P", "S"] for open-market buys and sells

since.description: Only filings on or after this date, e.g. "2026-01-01"

name: get_sec_insider_trades
title: Get SEC insider trades
